invariants.contract: A soft delete by a user with only delete permission answers 200 and removes the item, book, progress of every user, playlist entries (emptied playlist removed, other playlist renumbered), collection entries, the RSS feed and the metadata folder, while the media files stay. DELETE ?hard=1 additionally removes the item folder with its media files from disk (the parent folder stays) and answers 200. Deleting an already deleted item answers 404 and changes no row, file or event. Deleting a book whose author and series have other books keeps them (no author_removed or series_removed), removes the fixture progress of two users, the collection entry and the open feed, and renumbers nothing else. Deleting a podcast removes its episodes, their progress and playlist entries (the emptied playlist is removed), the open feed and the metadata folder.
